body.name: Tenant Administration
body.description: Tenant structure and direct protected actions for a tenant administrator.

permissions.label: Open Tenant Administration
permissions.description: Allows opening the Tenant Administration application.

permissions.label: Manage Tenant Administration
permissions.description: Allows managing Tenant Administration definition-level administration.

permissions.label: Read organisations
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected organisation projection as a system record.

permissions.label: Move organisations
permissions.description: Allows invoking an organisation move; the protected operation also requires the tenant reparent capability.

permissions.label: Read tenant administrators
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected tenant-administrator projection as a system record.

props.title: Tenant overview
props.text: Review the organisations in this tenant. Select an organisation to see its details, or use Tenant structure for its protected actions. Tenant administrators are listed on their own page.

props.title: First organisation steward
props.text: The signed-in administrator who creates this child organisation becomes its first organisation steward.

props.name: short_name
props.label: Short name
props.help_text: Use lowercase words separated by underscores.

props.name: steward_display_name
props.label: Your display name in the new organisation

props.name: language
props.label: Language
props.help_text: Enter a language tag such as en or en-NZ.

props.name: time_zone
props.label: Time zone
props.help_text: Enter an IANA time zone such as Pacific/Auckland.

props.name: currency
props.label: Currency
props.help_text: Enter a three-letter ISO currency code such as NZD.

props.title: Tenant administrators
props.text: Tenant administrators are read live from protected Identity data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records. Granting and revoking tenant-administrator access runs through IAM, never from this application.
